G=load(); print(sorted(G))

import json
pairs = json.load(open('programs/task-58b10949.json'))
if isinstance(pairs, dict): pairs = pairs.get('pairs', pairs)
print(type(pairs), len(pairs))
def path(p):
    inp, outp = p['input'], p['output']
    pts1 = [(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(outp) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v==1]
    pts2 = [(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(outp) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v==2]
    cells3 = [(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(outp) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v==3]
    return pts1[0], pts2[0], cells3
for i,p in enumerate(pairs):
    p1,p2,c3 = path(p)
    dr,dc = p2[0]-p1[0], p2[1]-p1[1]
    # classify cells
    rows = sorted({r for r,c in c3}); cols = sorted({c for r,c in c3})
    print(f'demo{i+1}: 1={p1} 2={p2} dr={dr} dc={dc} n3={len(c3)} min={min(abs(dr),abs(dc))} diff={abs(abs(dr)-abs(dc))}')
    # check straight run
    from collections import Counter
    rc = Counter(r for r,c in c3); cc = Counter(c for r,c in c3)
    print('  max rows same:', rc.most_common(2), 'max cols same:', cc.most_common(2))

    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])

    dr,dc=p2[0]-p1[0],p2[1]-p1[1]

def transform(grid):

    sr=1 if dr>0 else -1; sc=1 if dc>0 else -1
